annotations.title: Who owns the answer in my category? (quick, under $1)

description: Use when the user asks which brands or websites AI assistants rely on for their category and a quick read is enough. Asks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity two buyer questions live, once each, and returns the most-cited domains as counts of answers, whether the category is owned, led, contested or fragmented, and, if given, where your domain stands. Not the answers themselves. No stability check; buy a second run, or use run_answer_share, to see whether the leaders hold. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.74 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $1.06 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/answer-share-quick.json
